item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 02/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. It will be replaced by a warm and humid southerly airstream midweek this week. The weather will be misty in the morning and at night over the region. A cold front is expected to develop and move across Guangdong in the latter part of this week. There will be showers and a few thunderstorms over the region. The associated northeast monsoon will bring slightly cooler weather to the coastal areas.
